style.formality: Use "kamu", friendly and neutral, as Indonesian games do. Buttons use the plain imperative (Bagikan, Ambil, Mainkan).
style.gameTitles: Translate game titles: use the established Indonesian name of a classic solitaire when there is one (many are known by their English names, such as Klondike and FreeCell), translate descriptive titles, and keep proper names. The current titles are the `title` entries in content/games.json; when rules mention another game, use its Indonesian title.
style.cardIndices: Keep single-letter card indices (A, K, Q, J) as they are. Translate full rank and suit words. Indonesian nouns don't change for plurals; after a number use the singular (empat As).
style.markup: Keep {{placeholders}}, <tags>, line breaks and markdown (##, -, **) exactly.
